# Israel-Gaza war

[![Deputy Assistant Commissioner James Harman is wearing a police uniform and standing with the River Thames behind him.](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/be13/live/4c6f9600-be92-11f1-9f15-2f9dbc671f7d.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**Met Police urge students to move 7 October protest**\\
\\
The Met said it had tried to contact the University of London Coalition to postpone its protest.](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwkg5220l577o)

[![A young girl is seen in a hospital bed while a woman wearing scrubs strokes her hair](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/e9c7/live/7d112a00-bc92-11f1-bc1f-3f186ca4140c.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**Girl has multiple surgeries to control infections after strike in Gaza**\\
\\
Witnesses say Raseel's tent was hit by an Israeli helicopter strike. Israel’s military says it has no record of the attack.](https://www.bbc.com/news/videos/c8n5d0e0n6wdo)

[![Two university students with purple backpacks walk across a university campus. Only the backs of their heads are visible. One has short wavy dark hair and wears a black velvet jacket. She has her right arm around the second student, who has long dark hair.](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/01ec/live/ec7f30e0-bbfb-11f1-8422-17098b28f290.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns**\\
\\
The Community Security Trust says reported incidents are "substantially higher" than before the war in Gaza began.](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c9gk54r61yldo)

[![Ed Miliband behind a podium that says 'Hope Again'](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/a07e/live/c5336170-bb2c-11f1-a430-4d16ee157c41.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**Miliband - Gaza suffering is stain on conscience of the world**\\
\\
Ed Miliband says Labour will stand against those who seek the destruction of Israel but this "cannot justify the suffering the Netanyahu government has inflicted in Gaza and the West Bank".](https://www.bbc.com/news/videos/cq62kyl54w8go)

[![Split screen. Left, Nada Tawfik. Right, Benjamin Netanyahu.](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/8b80/live/1170daa0-b910-11f1-bc1f-3f186ca4140c.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**Why an international arrest warrant didn't stop Netanyahu's US trip**\\
\\
The BBC's Nada Tawfik explains why Israel's Benjamin Netanyahu was not arrested after speaking at the UN, despite an ICC arrest warrant.](https://www.bbc.com/news/videos/ckq633lm11jeo)

[![Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu speaks at the UN General Assembly in New York City. Photo: 24 September 2026](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/ef68/live/531a99b0-b851-11f1-b1d1-571ed4d7ff2c.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**Netanyahu defends Israeli military action as delegates walk out before UN speech**\\
\\
The Israeli leader labels those who left his speech at the UN General Assembly as "moral cowards".](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c3y0z7kxlegdo)

[![A split screen of an anti-Israel protest on the left and an image of Netanyahu on the right standing at a lectern.](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/4576/live/60ced1c0-b874-11f1-a430-4d16ee157c41.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**Watch: Protests and walkouts as Netanyahu addresses UN**\\
\\
The BBC’s Nada Tawfik explains what happened even before the Israeli prime minister took to the stage at the United Nations General Assembly in New York.](https://www.bbc.com/news/videos/cmvgy95g0n3lo)

[![Benjamin Netanyahu split screen with some empty UN seats.](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/cbc7/live/4d40df20-b844-11f1-b1d1-571ed4d7ff2c.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**Watch: UN delegates walk out of Netanyahu speech**\\
\\
The Israeli delegation cheered in support during Netanyahu's speech. Nada Tawfik in New York explains what happened.](https://www.bbc.com/news/videos/cqwyzmpm3pgdo)

[![Palestinians walk past the rubble of destroyed buildings in Gaza City, northern Gaza (22 September 2026)](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/7fb7/live/38baabd0-b7fe-11f1-bc1f-3f186ca4140c.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**Trump's Board of Peace unveils $2.45bn Gaza recovery plan**\\
\\
The figure was announced during a meeting of the group's board at the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York.](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwlyke0mm0x3o)

[![Composite image of Ed Sheeran and Charlotte Church performing](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/91f4/live/28fde910-b758-11f1-8e7f-6f99c81f3136.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**Charlotte Church accuses Ed Sheeran of choosing 'capitalism over doing the right thing'**\\
\\
Charlotte Church says Ed Sheeran chose capitalism over "doing the right thing".](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cj207y2xp65ko)

[![French President Emmanuel Macron addresses the UN General Assembly in New York (22 September 2026)](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/2d5e/live/7a241870-b73d-11f1-b1d1-571ed4d7ff2c.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**Netanyahu calls Macron's remarks on West Bank in UN speech 'grotesque'**\\
\\
Israel's PM denounces the French president after he appeared to downplay Hamas's activities in the occupied territory.](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ck1l6yyg52qvo)

[![A file photo showing a Palestinian woman inspecting her damaged home after an Israeli strike on a nearby mosque, in Gaza City (29 July 2026)](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/7adb/live/a6e48140-b717-11f1-bc1f-3f186ca4140c.jpg.webp)\\
\\
**Reports of violence against women in Gaza surge, UN agency finds**\\
\\
The UN Population Fund also says there has been a "severe escalation" in the number of early and forced marriages.](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c94gm7dp40y0o)
